name: gaabe-education
description: Gaabe Institute — bilingual (Dhivehi/English) Islamic education platform. Isolated from all other Tech.Tasks projects.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gaabe/student-web && npm run build -w @gaabe/admin-web
scripts.deploy:demo:student: npm run build -w @gaabe/student-web && wrangler deploy --config apps/student-web/wrangler.jsonc --old-asset-ttl 86400
scripts.deploy:demo:admin: npm run build -w @gaabe/admin-web && wrangler deploy --config apps/admin-web/wrangler.jsonc --old-asset-ttl 86400
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck:email && npm run typecheck:payments && npm run test && npm run build
